VERDICT, THE IDENTITY WAVE (2026-08-22), verbatim: "merge the New Youngbloods." new-youngbloods-giwf (Lew Spectre & Lyle Wile, GIWF, 1999-2001, a 24-day World Tag Team Championship reign) folded into the-youngbloods — Lew Spectre already an IWF-era Youngblood, the GIWF billing scare-quoting itself "'New'" as a deliberate in-fiction continuity marker rather than an unrelated coincidence. Lyle Wile added to the roster as the GIWF-era member; the existing GIWF tenure entry (already on file, same 1999-2001 window) enriched with the reign detail rather than duplicated.

notes: One long-running stable with evolving membership across three feds — not a revival or a coincidence. Membership lists are era-tagged where sourced; the UWF-era (2004) lineup is not recovered. "The most dominant stable ever in the IWF." Psycho, Cloak and Hercules/Tank were largely one handler writing against himself, in the IWF era. The GIWF-era billing scare-quoted itself "'New' Youngbloods" — not a coincidental revival but this same stable's own membership continuing forward: Lew Spectre (an IWF-era Youngblood) paired with new member Lyle Wile, managed by Richard Ray Vaughn (another IWF-era Youngblood), holding a 24-day GIWF World Tag Team Championship reign under the name.
caption: One long-running stable across three federations and a decade, from IWF Stable of the Year through a GIWF Stable Wars win and a 24-day GIWF World Tag Team Championship reign to a UWF tag reign whose own lineup was never recovered.
